title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-02-08

ai_review.summary: Fair‑quality matrix tape of a ’70s show highlighted by an unforgettable Smokestack Lightning and a rare St. Stephen > Not Fade Away sandwich.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its strong setlist, with Smokestack Lightning singled out as possibly the best ever and a uniquely arranged St. Stephen → Not Fade Away → St. Stephen sequence that adds an intriguing stillness. Recording quality is described as only fair – not pristine and occasionally problematic – but it’s good enough to enjoy the great playing of Jerry and Bob.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews consistently note a high‑level musical show (standout songs, strong playing) while flagging modest recording flaws; weighted average yields ~4.1 stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound is not pristine – occasional muffled or noisy sections and general ‘not the best’ quality, but the tape is complete enough to be listenable.

standout_songs: St. Stephen > Not Fade Away > St. Stephen
show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows well, featuring a rare Smokestack Lightning highlight and an unusual St. Stephen/NFA sandwich that adds both tension and a cool segue.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His guitar work is highlighted in the duel during Smokestack Lightning’s final break.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob (referred to as Bobby) shares the duel with Jerry on Smokestack Lightning, showing strong interplay.
